verdict: Leads are coming in, but local visibility dropped sharply this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 41 leads at a cost of $38.39 per lead across $1,573.82 in total ad spend, with all paid leads coming through Meta. Cost per lead improved roughly 9% compared to the prior week, which is a positive sign on the paid side. However, Google Business Profile actions fell 74% week-over-week and organic search clicks went to zero for the last three days of the period, meaning fewer people are finding you through local and unpaid channels right now — likely a combination of seasonal demand shifting and a gap in heating-season content and search presence that is being addressed. We are moving this week to stabilize Google Ads delivery, which saw erratic spend patterns, and to get overdue heating campaign assets live ahead of peak season. Expect local visibility metrics to be a key focus point in the next report.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all through paid social
average cost per lead, down ~9% from the prior week
actions taken on your Google Business profiles this period (calls, direction requests, and website clicks)

watch_item.fix: Heating-season content and search presence work is being prioritized now to recover local visibility before peak demand.
